name: grenite-realworld-example
description: Grenite implementation of the RealWorld backend API, backed by the Supabase HTTP API (PostgREST) via Docker.

scripts.db:prepare: docker compose exec -T -e PGPASSWORD=postgres db psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < db/schema.sql && docker compose restart rest
